readiness.hed: Fredericksburg holds mild and dry into the holiday weekend — mostly cloudy near 54 this afternoon with gusty southwest wind, clearing to sunny stretches near 60-61 Saturday and Sunday before rain returns Sunday night
readiness.insight: No active alerts are in effect for the Fredericksburg area this afternoon. This afternoon stays mostly cloudy near 54 with southwest wind gusting to 23 mph; tonight holds mostly cloudy near 41 with gusts to 20 mph. Saturday turns sunny near 60 and Sunday mostly sunny near 61 — a clean, dry window for the rest of the holiday weekend — before rain showers return Sunday night with a 100% chance of precipitation.
actions: Gusts run 20-23 mph through tonight — secure any loose holiday decorations, trash cans or yard items still out.
Saturday and Sunday both clear out dry and mild — the best windows this weekend for outdoor cleanup, travel or errands.
Rain returns Sunday night with a 100% chance of precipitation — plan any outdoor activity for daytime hours before it moves in.
No watches or warnings are posted; this is routine late-November wind and cloud cover, not a storm signal.
